title: India government denies hiding information on Operation Sindhur martyrs
summary: The Indian government has denied allegations that it is hiding information about the victims of Operation Sindhur, a military operation in Pakistan. Congress party has accused the government of not providing accurate information about the operation and its casualties. The government has stated that the claim is incorrect and has clarified its stance on the matter.
summary_points: Operation Sindhur was a military operation conducted by India against terrorist camps in Pakistan
The Indian government has denied allegations of hiding information about the victims of Operation Sindhur
Congress party has accused the government of not providing accurate information about the operation and its casualties
The government has stated that the claim is incorrect and has clarified its stance on the matter
